units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>כשסִרְסַרְתָּ לישראל וכ׳</he> (not <he>כשסדרת</he>) when thou wast the agent for Israel (conveying the Law to them), I gave thee as a reward &c. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Leviticus 6">Vayikra 6</cite> <he>היו מְסַרְסְרִין זה לזה וכ׳</he> they were the agents (pimped) for one another in sins; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 309">Yalk. Jer. 309</cite>.
